content.text: The redline validates. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: the right to use, a computer system on which the Site will be stored and operated, with a direct Internet connection of shared but greater than T-1 bandwidth, plus capacity to process continuously during burst periods. HDI shall also provide the Company with access to HDI's software and Content administration tools for purposes of allowing the Company to monitor current catalog information.
input.rationale: Section 1.4 is the only grant running in our favour (access to and the right to use HDI's computer system, software and Content administration tools). It names only "the Company," so our affiliates and any contractors acting on our behalf (e.g. developers or agencies handling Content) are outside the grant with no path to add them, contrary to the preferred position. The grant is also silent on duration and revocability: nothing prevents HDI from withdrawing or suspending access at will short of terminating under Section 4.1, and although Section 10.3 binds successors and assigns, it does not confirm the access rights travel to a successor. The redline adds affiliates and contractors, ties revocation to termination or our uncured material breach, and confirms successor transfer; fallback is affiliate coverage on written notice plus M&A successor transfer.

proposal.summary: Extend the Section 1.4 access/use grant to the Company's affiliates and contractors, and make it non-revocable and transferable to a successor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Section 1.4 access and use rights to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, and confirmed that HDI cannot revoke or suspend the grant at will or block transfer to a successor. Our playbook requires licence and access grants to cover affiliates and contractors and to be terminable only on termination of the Agreement or our uncured material breach; if HDI prefers, we can accept affiliate coverage on written notice to HDI as a fallback.

ops.text: The access and use rights granted to the Company under this Section 1.4 shall extend to the Company's affiliates and to contractors acting on the Company's behalf, shall remain in effect for the term of this Agreement and may not be revoked, suspended or restricted by HDI except upon termination of this Agreement in accordance with Section 4.1 or upon a material breach by the Company that remains uncured thirty (30) days after written notice thereof, and shall be transferable to any successor to the Company's business by merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets.
